LESSON: POOL SAFETY HYGIENE

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: SWIMMING
Topic 14.1: Pool safety hygiene

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Pool safety hygiene. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify basic water safety rules 15 lessons
2. apply basic water safety rule in the pool for personal safety
3. have fun as they role play basic water safety rules in the pool
4. display ability to use safety materials in water for security efforts.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify basic water safety rules 15 lessons
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify basic water safety rules 15 lessons. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. apply basic water safety rule in the pool for personal safety
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to apply basic water safety rule in the pool for personal safety. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. have fun as they role play basic water safety rules in the pool
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to have fun as they role play basic water safety rules in the pool. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. display ability to use safety materials in water for security efforts.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to display ability to use safety materials in water for security efforts. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Pool safety hygiene.
2. Explain Pool safety hygiene to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should watch a film on b) apply basic water safety rule in swimming safety gears. before getting into a the pool for personal safety
4. Show that you can: identify basic water safety rules 15 lessons
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Pool safety hygiene. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Pool safety hygiene important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Watch a film on b) apply basic water safety rule in swimming safety gears. before getting into a the pool for personal safety
2. Enjoy using basic water rules

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify basic water safety rules 15 lessons
2. apply basic water safety rule in the pool for personal safety
3. have fun as they role play basic water safety rules in the pool
4. display ability to use safety materials in water for security efforts.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
